system.description:
Old rivalries and secret ambitions dissolve in your presence. You compel even bitter enemies to set aside their distrust and work together.

Spend a Willpower Trait to activate this power for the duration of the scene. Everyone in the same area becomes more favorably disposed toward one another and more willing to extend trust or make cooperative plans. The effects are chiefly roleplayed, but there is one firm rule: anyone who would frenzy while the power is in effect makes a simple test, and on a success the frenzy is avoided.
